snapshot.title: Example Domain
snapshot.raw_html:
Example Domain

This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.

Learn more
snapshot.summary:
- Main purpose: A simple static placeholder/example page that demonstrates a basic web page and directs users to additional information (typically used in documentation/tests).
- Main interactive element/flow: Click the "Learn more" link which navigates off-site (usually to IANA/example info); no login, search, or form interactions.
- Secondary flows: Keyboard navigation to the link, opening the link in a new tab/window, copy/paste of content, page load and responsive/resizing behavior.
- Content expectations: Static text, single prominent heading and paragraph, predictable layout across browsers.
- Accessibility expectations: Link must be reachable by keyboard, have visible focus, and readable by screen readers (correct semantics/alt text not applicable).
- Performance/availability edge cases: Slow network, offline/cache, mixed-content or SSL certificate issues for the external link.
- Navigation edge cases: External link missing, broken, redirects, or opens in unexpected context (same tab vs new tab), and link text/URL mismatch.
- Rendering edge cases: Very small or very large viewports, high-contrast/zoomed text, and browsers with JS disabled (page should still be usable).
